[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] '''Mairayni''' was a [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarch]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The [[Gender/Legends|female]] was the sixth ruler to reign after [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]]<ref name="EGTWAC" /> whose reign ended in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Pars Varqom]], a member of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], served under Mairayni as a [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guard]] prior to retiring. Varqom mentioned his service to the queen in the [[Royal Archives of Naboo, Vol. 2453|2453rd volume]] of the [[Royal Archives of Naboo]].<ref name="EGTWAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mairiyani was created for ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' a [[2012]] reference book written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]. The character was to be mentioned in a section titled titled "A Soldier's Story: Naboo Invaded," but the section was cut from the published version. The section was later published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[March 18]], [[2014]], as part of the sixth entry of a [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|blog series]] that released cut content from the guide.<ref name="EGTWAC" />
